Notes.raw: Continued working for CIVITAS into the fall semester to make a little bit of money. Also worked weekends (sat-sun) at Tiger Sguar and then I did HU-ILEAD for the spring semester. Secured a summer internship at Ryan late last year. CIVITAS gave me a $500 bonus listed on my last paycheck too which was nice. Quit the boba job when summer started and took about a week off from Ryan to hike with friends. Also had one of my paychecks at tiger sugar sent over through zelle. Also for some reason my last paycheck at tiger sugar was $17.50/hr instead of $14. Randomly got the first week of SYEP pay, so made $200 while doing nothing. Working at Ryan is terrible and I definitely can see myself at CIVITAS; there's just so much time I'm spend doing nothing and I don't really fit in here. I ended up choosing CIVITAS for the full time offer.

Notes.raw: I continued working for CIVITAS part-time, while waiting to start full time. While working part-time, they paid me the same $20/hr over the full-time salaried that we signed. I also continued as a reasearch assistant for Dr. Sharma. He ended up paying me and Sarah more this semester than the last. I started doing tax preparation services for TurboTax, contracted through HighSpring. It was mostly customer support for self-service customers and then the occasional full-service customers. I like doing taxes, not really providing customer support, so I quit. I also didn't really have the timefor it. I bit off much more than I could chew and practically every hour outside of school was being spent at work, whether that was at Civitas or TurboTax, and I could feel how unsustainable that was, so I left. I only ended up working there for a couple of weeks.

Summary.raw: Zero-calorie, zero-sugar hibiscus tea sweetened with stevia.
Summary.formatted: Zero-calorie, zero-sugar hibiscus tea sweetened with stevia.

Ingredients.raw:
1 cup dried hibiscus flowers
8 quarts (2 gallons) water
1/16 tsp pure stevia extract
Ingredients.formatted:
1 cup dried hibiscus flowers
8 quarts (2 gallons) water
1/16 tsp pure stevia extract

Directions.raw:
1. Fill infuser with hibiscus.
2. Heat 6 quarts water to boiling.
3. Steep 40 minutes.
4. Remove infuser.
5. Add stevia while warm and stir.
6. Pour into dispenser.
7. Add cold water to reach 2 gallons.
8. Chill and adjust sweetness to taste.
Directions.formatted:
1. Fill infuser with hibiscus.
2. Heat 6 quarts water to boiling.
3. Steep 40 minutes.
4. Remove infuser.
5. Add stevia while warm and stir.
6. Pour into dispenser.
7. Add cold water to reach 2 gallons.
8. Chill and adjust sweetness to taste.
